CDN77 (operated by DataCamp Limited, UK) guarantees 99.99% monthly CDN uptime with credit remedies up to 100% of monthly fees. The claim deadline is unusually strict: written notice must be submitted **within the same calendar month** as the breach — filing on or after the first day of the following month forfeits the claim. Specific credit tier thresholds require direct review.
